security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; media-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Read local Markdown files as a polished document.
bundle.longDescription: Inkfin opens a single local .md or .markdown file and renders it as a GitHub Flavoured Markdown document, with syntax highlighting, themes, visible text search, document zoom and automatic refresh when the file changes on disk. Read-only: nothing is written to your documents and no network requests are made.
